definitions.explanation: A person who speaks or acts on behalf of others or a group.
The act of speaking or acting on behalf of others; being a symbol or example of something.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{日本|にほん}{代表|だいひょう}として{出場|しゅつじょう}した。
examples.english: He participated as a representative of Japan.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}を{代表|だいひょう}して{挨拶|あいさつ}します。
examples.english: I will give a greeting on behalf of this company.

examples.japanese: {富士山|ふじさん}は{日本|にほん}を{代表|だいひょう}する{山|やま}だ。
examples.english: Mt. Fuji is a mountain that represents Japan.

examples.japanese: {各|かく}クラスから{代表|だいひょう}を{一人|ひとり}{選|えら}ぶ。
examples.english: One representative is chosen from each class.

examples.japanese: {代表者|だいひょうしゃ}として{会議|かいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
examples.english: I attended the meeting as a representative.

examples.japanese: {寿司|すし}は{日本|にほん}を{代表|だいひょう}する{食|た}べ{物|もの}だ。
examples.english: Sushi is a food that represents Japan.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {代表者|だいひょうしゃ} (representative person)
- {代表取締役|だいひょうとりしまりやく} (representative director, CEO)
- {代表チーム|だいひょうちーむ} (national team)
- {代表作|だいひょうさく} (representative work, masterpiece)

GRAMMAR:
- 〜を{代表|だいひょう}する: to represent ~
- 〜を{代表|だいひょう}して: on behalf of ~

COLLOCATIONS:
- {代表|だいひょう}に{選|えら}ばれる (to be chosen as representative)
- {代表|だいひょう}を{務|つと}める (to serve as representative)
